Ingredients:
175g chicken breast
75g basmati rice
80g broccoli
1 tbsp olive oil
2 garlic cloves
Salt & pepper
Method:
Cook the rice as per the packet
Griddle the chicken 6 minutes each side
Steam the broccoli and combine

Ingredients:
60g porridge oats
200ml semi skimmed milk
150g 0% Greek yoghurt
1 medium banana
1 tbsp honey
Method:
Mix the oats, milk and yoghurt
Top with the banana and honey
Chill overnight

Ingredients:
200g porridge oats
100g peanut butter
80g honey
50g whey protein
Method:
Blend everything together
Roll into 12 balls
Chill for 2 hours
